title: Iku (a Woman’s Name)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: She is mentioned in [Taanit 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.25a.7): she was Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa’s neighbor and complained to him that she was building a house and the beams were too short. He asked her name; she said, “Iku.” He said: “Iku, may your beams stretch.”

notes.text: The linked text plays on Iku as her name and “if so” at the start of Rabbi Chanina’s reply. It reads נימטו, “may they reach,” where the supplied Hebrew has נממי. [The continuation](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.25a.8) gives different accounts of how the beams extended.
